name: ООО «БК «Олимп» (OLIMPBET bookmaker)
note: Licensed bookmaker (ФНС/EGRUL: ООО "БК "Олимп", ИНН 7726705980) operating the OLIMPBET brand (olimp.bet). Per EGRUL data republished by RusProfile (archived 2025-12-22), 97.5% is held by ООО «Зевс» and 2.5% by its long-time general director Sergey Kozyavkin.
